eval.title: INMODE STOCK HAS IT ALL!!!!

call.headline_quote: this is not a value investment this is nothing even close to what i do even if the fundamentals look good but reward me as a shareholder and then we can talk about good fundamentals

what_is_priced_in.quote: at eight-time sales they need to grow a lot to justify the price if they don't grow we can go to two-time sales quickly and then we are still 75 percent lower

reasons.claim: Cash keeps piling up on the balance sheet instead of being returned to shareholders as dividends, which is a red flag despite promised buybacks.
reasons.quote: why are they not paying 100 million to 100 million in dividends they're doing some buybacks maybe from themselves or etc who knows i didn't look deeper because i'm absolutely not interested

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Shares outstanding keep increasing despite a promised buyback, suggesting management is rewarding itself rather than shareholders.
reasons.quote: they said they will make 1 million shares buyback but you can see that those shares are continuing to increase so likely the management is happy in rewarding themselves

reasons.claim: At eight times sales the stock needs a lot of continued growth to justify the price; if growth stalls the multiple could compress sharply, implying much further downside.
reasons.quote: at eight-time sales they need to grow a lot to justify the price if they don't grow we can go to two-time sales quickly and then we are still 75 percent lower

data_check.gap_note: he says 8, as-of 3.57565e+08 (FY2021); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: The business has few patents and an easily replicable product, so if it works competitors will copy it, undermining durability.
reasons.quote: eight patents is a lot compared to 3m with 118 000 but okay they do what they do

reasons.claim: Growth has already stopped a little this quarter, which he sees as a warning sign consistent with prior medical-treatment company hype cycles.
reasons.quote: over the last 20 years i've seen these medical treatment companies do the same thing and this all looks equal to all the previous shenanigans that happened

external_facts_used: Company presentation details: sales team of ~150-189 people in 77 countries
market opportunity of 100,000 surgically trained physicians in the US and 200,000 globally
celebrity endorsement (Paula Abdul) used in marketing
management backgrounds/education from prior affiliated companies

critic.notes: ok. Reason 1 quote slightly paraphrased ('why are they not' vs 'why aren't they'); reason 5 category 'cyclicality' is a stretch but the claim itself is supported.
